spec.base: all vocabulary/hidden parameters frozen for every update in both arms
spec.decoding: greedy, empty response prefix, 160 bytes, EOS 0, rolling 256-byte context
spec.exit: sigmoid on concatenated frozen query/source hidden states; initial weight zero bias 4; exit >=0.5
spec.gates: no original exact hit lost, improved complete dev replies, functional improvement; no promotion in pilot
spec.limits: Bundled mechanism comparison, not single-factor or equal-compute attribution. Same examples/updates, different heads/loss queries. One seed, fixed coefficient, no tuning. Exposed development and six Docker probes are regressions, not fresh holdout. Native FP32 heads have no cross-CPU certificate. Hard cursor/trigger are decoding assistance, not learned monotonicity or original native support.
spec.mechanism: one trigger only when autonomous output equals def-space; learned source start over prompt bytes; copy one byte and increment absolute cursor; learned exit delegates unchanged vocabulary forever; lost/out-of-prompt cursor also delegates; generated bytes never eligible; no name parser
spec.schedule: namespace-retention diverse, 512 updates; originals full, aliases prefix first 128
spec.sequential: response NLL + first-name source-start NLL + 0.1 name/exit BCE
spec.soft: unchanged v1 mixture; response NLL + all-name position NLL + 0.1 response gate BCE
spec.training_cursor: gold TRAIN source positions; first name byte uses soft pointer; later name/exit uses hard cursor
